cohort: The participants were near-term lambs delivered at 140 days of gestation (term = 150 days) from asthmatic ewes randomized to receive antenatal betamethasone or saline, and control lambs from non-asthmatic ewes.
finding: Antenatal betamethasone stimulated lung maturation and function in near-term neonates, increasing dynamic lung compliance and expression of surfactant protein genes SFTPA and SFTPB, even without maternal asthma-induced impairment, and female lambs showed better lung function and surfactant gene expression than males.
gest_age: 140 days of gestation (delivery), 138-139 days of gestation (betamethasone administration)
